This page has 3 tables of quests: the heroic quests, the epic quests and the legendary quests.

  • If you prefer one table per level, then you may use the navigation box at the bottom left of your screen to get to the level pages.
  • If you prefer one table per adventure pack, then you may visit the adventure pack's page.
  • If you prefer one table per patron, then you may visit that patron's page.

Free to Play accounts can buy individual Adventure Packs to gain access to VIP quests. Sometimes these are offered bundled as special sales, and some may have been moved to "F2P" status.
